title: Compact-to-Hausdorff continuous bijections
statement: Let $X,Y$ be topological spaces and $U\subseteq X$, $V\subseteq Y$ subsets, endowed with their subspace topologies [def-kun-subspace-topology]. If $U$ is quasi-compact and $V$ is Hausdorff, every continuous bijection $f:U\to V$ is a homeomorphism.
